context.transcript:
Good afternoon, everyone. As chief operating officer, one
of my responsibilities is to look for ways to reduce costs.
With this in mind, the executive leadership team and I
have made the decision to consolidate our company from
two locations to one-and one of our buildings will be
sold. And since many of you have expressed interest in
hybrid work schedules, employees will be able to work
from home or in the office on different days of the week.
Please think about a schedule that would best suit your
work productivity. Be sure to discuss it with your manager
by the end of this week.
context.transcript_translation: 大家下午好。作为首席运营官，我的一项职责是寻找降低成本的方法。出于这一考虑，我和公司高管团队决定把公司从两个办公地点整合到一个，其中一栋办公楼将被出售。另外，由于许多人表示对混合办公安排感兴趣，员工将可以在一周中的不同日期选择居家或到办公室工作。请考虑一下哪种日程最有利于提高你的工作效率，并务必在本周结束前与你的经理讨论。
context.content_translation: 本段听力围绕“办公楼调整”展开。请先听清人物关系和对话目的，再抓取时间、地点、原因、行动等关键信息。
